Tracking the Four-Domain Collapse Across Six Generations (1900â€“2025)

**The Hypothesis:** Social coherence collapses in a predictable sequence.
**Words fail first**â€”semantic meaning erodes before structures collapse.
Then **Family**, then **Institutions**, then **Economy**.
The data across 125 years confirms this cascade.

sections.title: Causal Events by Domain
sections.text:
### SEMANTIC DRIFT
* 1926 Henry must EXPLAIN "duty" to sons
* 1950 Words become advertising slogans
* 1974 "Integrity" only used as accusation
* 1998 "Friend" = screen name
* 2025 Words require conscious CHOICE

sections.title: FAMILIAL COLLAPSE
sections.text:
* 1950 "Ball and chain" jokes begin
* 1969 California no-fault divorce
* 1974 Divorce rate 4.6/1000
* 1998 33% unmarried age 30-39
* 2025 46% unmarried, family optional

sections.title: INSTITUTIONAL COLLAPSE
sections.text:
* 1958 Peak trust: 73%
* 1974 Watergate: trust drops to 36%
* 1998 "They all lie" as baseline
* 2025 Record lows: <20% trust

sections.title: ECONOMIC UNMOORING
sections.text:
* 1971 Nixon ends gold standard
* 1974 Inflation hits 12.3%
* 1998 Two incomes = one 1950 income
* 2025 Gig economy, no pensions
